nodes.label: ParkHooshmand (Tehran Smart Parking)
nodes.rationale: Smart curbside-parking platform for Iranian cities; bilingual fa/en with RTL, light/dark, responsive to 360px, PWA-ready. FastAPI backend + Next.js 15 frontend.

nodes.label: Security/Performance/UI Hardening Handoff
nodes.rationale: Written 2026-10-02 so another model can continue the audit without redoing discovery; only phase 0 (scouting, scans) is done.

nodes.label: Red Team / Blue Team Multi-Agent Workflow
nodes.norm_label: red team / blue team multi-agent workflow
nodes.rationale: Parallel red-team finders per area, each finding checked by an independent skeptic, then one blue-team fixer per area and a final verifier.

nodes.label: Same-Origin Reverse Proxy for /api and /ws
nodes.rationale: Serving both services from one origin lets CORS be locked down, enables CSP connect-src 'self', and avoids mixed-content ws:// failures.

nodes.label: B8: Balance Check/Deduct Race (no lock)
nodes.rationale: Sync endpoints run in a thread pool, so concurrent requests can both pass the balance or zone-full check; do check-and-deduct atomically.

nodes.label: B9: SESSIONS Grows Without Bound (memory DoS)

nodes.label: Per-User Identity and Wallets (signed device token)
nodes.norm_label: per-user identity and wallets (signed device token)
nodes.rationale: Minimum fix for shared wallet and unowned sessions: anonymous signed device token, ideally real auth; bind sessions to owners with secrets.token_urlsafe(16) IDs.
